subject: Gen5 source review: isolate virtual angle from semantic ingress and bypass legacy TiltFollower when trusted
body:
CURRENT_HEAD=bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea
ROLE=independent Manager peer reviewer; no production writes.

CONFIRMED CURRENT-MAIN SOURCE:
1) FoldOverlayService.drainHingeIngress() replays every authoritative physical sample into continuity.onHinge() first, then sends only the final real angle to gen3Visual.onHinge() and PanelEngine.onHinge(). Therefore HingeAngleSource/Fold7AngleAuthority/Fold7HingeIngressBatch is the semantic authority boundary and is NOT a safe injection point for virtual/predicted angle.
2) Current Fold7 opening composition is delegated from Fold7Gen3VisualCoordinator to PanelEngine. PanelEngine creates a TiltFollower for the visual surface. The explicit continuity-opening path sets CONTINUITY_OPENING_TAU_S=0.09s; Samsung live-angle tracking uses 0.028s. A trusted Gen5 vsync predictor piped through PanelEngine.onHinge()->TiltFollower would therefore be smoothed again and reintroduce visual phase lag.
3) Current main has no first-useful-inner presentation oracle. The earlyOpeningVisualLatched field/timeout exists in FoldOverlayService, but source review finds no call that sets the latch true. Actual opening visual lifetime is the Gen3 visual attempt surviving OPENING_FROM_CLOSED + INNER_HANDOFF, plus its 2500ms safety timeout. It is not gated by launcher/widget/content readiness.

REVIEW CONSTRAINT / RECOMMENDED INTEGRATION CONTRACT:
- Keep measuredAngle -> hingeIngress -> continuity/wake/panel/native semantic path unchanged.
- Add a parallel renderAngle/vsync path owned only by the opening visual attempt. Trusted virtual output should drive the renderer directly (bounded per-frame slew/reversal guards) without legacy TiltFollower smoothing.
- Retain TiltFollower only as degraded/low-confidence fallback after virtual confidence collapse.
- Never let virtual renderAngle call continuity.onHinge(), WakeInner, panel prepare/reassert/return, native handoff, task migration, or cycle/generation mutation.
- Reacquisition correction must remain visual-only and cannot synthesize terminal completion.
- Lane C should introduce an explicit opening-presentation token/readiness contract rather than treating INNER_HANDOFF/topology or the currently inert earlyOpeningVisualLatched field as useful-pixel readiness.

DISPOSITION=NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE for implementation, but these are source-confirmed architectural constraints that should gate promotion of Lanes A/C/I.
NEXT=Require lane artifacts/proposed Kotlin touchpoints to preserve this two-channel separation and prove direct-vsync trusted output; reject proposals that inject virtual angle upstream of the semantic boundary or double-smooth it.
